יהוה אל שדי, Jehova, Deus sufficiens: quo qui fruitur,

l.i: Sat jam sæpe tulit vaga per divortia mentem
Hinc Thetis, hinc Tellus, arduus inde Polus.
Vel totum injectis mundum si metiar ulnis,
Non tamen hæc ulnis par erit ulna meis.
Quod neque sideri claudunt amplexibus orbes,
Id voto spes est resque petita meo.
Hactenus, heu fateor! vacuas dum prendimus auras,
Semper ab amplexu mens male lusa suo est.
Sis mihi Terra, Deus; mihi Tu Mare; Tu mihi Cœlum!
Sis Tu cuncta mihi; Te sine, cuncta nihil!

page.notes: Printed verse is set in italic; the word-initial long s is rendered as s. "Quod" and "Hactenus" read as printed; "sideri" is uncertain for printed "fideri" and is marked accordingly in the verse as read. The catchword/running element "EXER-" is taken as a catchword at the foot.
